reserveReview.rationale: The September 14 issuer transparency API identifies USTB and BUIDL in an unleveraged Ethereum wallet portfolio. Named positions are reported in USD millions to $1,000 precision; total equity is more precise. The difference is retained as an unclassified residual rather than assigned to named funds. Static percentages are rounded to two decimals; live weights use the source amounts and total. This is issuer-reported portfolio evidence, not independent examination.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mTBILL transparency API updatedAt 2026-09-14T13:06:24.130Z; USD-million position values and reconciled total equity, with explicit residual
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Approximately 0.0323% of source equity is the difference between total equity and rounded named positions. Smaller holdings, rounding and their custody identities remain unresolved; the live adapter preserves the full residual.
